import torch,torch_npu,triton,traceback,inspect,sys
from triton.backends.ascend.testing import do_bench_npu
print('TIMER_SOURCE',inspect.getsource(do_bench_npu))
torch.npu.set_device(0)
for shape,dim in [((1048576,),None),((64,64),1)]:
 x=torch.randn(shape,device='npu',dtype=torch.float32)
 f=lambda:torch.amin(x,dim=dim)
 try:
  y=f();torch.npu.synchronize();print('TORCH',shape,y.shape)
  print('TIME',do_bench_npu(f))
 except Exception:traceback.print_exc()
